name: @media-router/plugin-teletext-subtitles
description: Teletext subtitle decoder — one MPEG-TS input carrying DVB teletext, one subtitle output per configured page

mediaRouter.description: Decodes the DVB teletext stream in an MPEG-TS once and turns each configured subtitle page (888, 692, …) into its own subtitle output. Wire a subtitle output into the Subtitles In port of a Video Player (rendered on the display) or a Video Transcoder (burned into every rendition). Subtitle outputs are MPEG-TS on the bus like everything else, so they also travel through SRT/RIST outputs and the MPEG-TS muxer.

pages.description: Teletext subtitle pages to decode — "+ Add" creates another subtitle output port. The page numbers and languages a service carries are listed in its PMT teletext descriptor (the TS Splitter shows the teletext PID); common subtitle pages are 888 (English) and the 6xx range.

language.description: ISO 639-2 language code (eng, nor, fra, …) — carried in the subtitle stream's name channel

cueHoldSeconds.description: Longest a subtitle stays on screen when the broadcaster never sends a clear for it. Teletext subtitles are normally erased by the next page or an explicit blank page; this is the safety net.
